description: Planted defects in greenwashed-app. Every entry is a check that cannot fail, deliberately written into a suite that is 100% green. `canfail verify-fixtures` asserts that canfail finds all of them and reports nothing else, which is what stops canfail from silently degrading into a tool that always prints zero.

planted.note: expect(true).toBe(true) holds regardless of the code
the one test covering the unsafe threshold is it.skip
catch swallows the failure so the test passes either way
database unreachable, endpoint still returns ok:true
throttled upstream returned as an empty HTTP 200
MOCK_PRODUCT reachable from the production entry point
fake 800ms delay in front of the placeholder so the UI looks live
allergen threshold comparison can be inverted and the suite stays green
the 'unsafe' verdict can be replaced with a sentinel unnoticed
the 'safe' verdict can be replaced with a sentinel unnoticed
the configuration guard can be negated without failing api.test.ts
the returned catalogue can be replaced with a sentinel unnoticed
